title: Document the two new NPT dynamics: IsotropicMTKNPT and MTKNPT.
body:
Add documentation of the two new kinds of dynamics added by @lan496 in MR !3550 and !3595.

# Checklist: `x` (done) or `~` (irrelevant)

- [X] [I am familiar with **ASE's contribution guidelines.**](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/contribute.html)

author: schiotz

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Thanks for adding this.  For consistency, could you use our custom :doi:`...` role please?

comments.author: AndrewRosen
comments.body: Should we add a deprecation period and warning to `NPT`?

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: Deprecation implies future removal or other API change. I don't think we really want to remove this if it is a correct implementation of a documented method? Perhaps rename to `MelchionnaNPT` instead?

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: I have removed "deprecated" for now, let's do the magic in another PR

comments.author: AndrewRosen
comments.body: Thanks for documenting this, @schiotz! I wasn't aware of the planned deprecation, so we will switch over now that we know! Looking forward to the next release with `MTKNPT` --- thanks @lan496!!!

comments.author: schiotz
comments.body: We are not planning to remove it, it is just that NPT is unstable and sometimes behaving very badly. MTKNPT should be much better behaved.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
We should probably not say it's deprecated unless we actually deprecate it in favour of some other (permanent) way of doing things.

But I think if the method is implemented correctly and we want to keep it, then we should just have a very visible note in the docstring recommending that people use a different method.

comments.author: schiotz
comments.body: I agree.  I'll change the text, then.

comments.author: AndrewRosen
comments.body: @askhl: One of my concerns is that, in practice, few people probably read the docstrings, especially if they are using some external library that calls ASE. If `NPT` really is not ideal to use, should we consider raising a `UserWarning`?

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body:
We could rename NPT to MelchionnaNPT and keep NPT as an alias that raises DeprecationWarning to use the more explicit name (and advertises the alternatives.)

Then, after a generous period, remove the alias.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: I discussed with @askhl  and @yuzie007 today and they are also happy with this kind of organisation. Looks like we have a consensus!

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: I have made a few tweaks with DOIs and snazzy info boxes. Let's play with deprecation in a separate MR! If somebody already in the discussion approves my changes we can merge.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: Created #1732 to take over deprecation/rename idea.
